verdict: Palantir's revenue grew 70% to $1.41B as U.S. commercial revenue jumped 137%, and net income reached $611M — 43% of revenue — because running costs grew far more slowly than sales.

segments.name: Government
segments.note: Software for the U.S. military, intelligence agencies and allied governments — U.S. government revenue alone grew 66% to $570M.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Software for companies — U.S. commercial revenue jumped 137% to $507M as businesses raced to put AI to work, and U.S. commercial remaining deal value hit $4.38B, up 145% YoY.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Sales teams and the 'bootcamp' try-before-you-buy push that has been winning commercial customers.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the platforms — Gotham, Foundry and the AIP AI layer.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company: legal, finance and offices.

takeaways.title: U.S. commercial is exploding
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue more than doubled to $507M, and the pipeline points the same way: U.S. commercial remaining deal value hit $4.38B, up 145% YoY.

takeaways.title: A 41% operating margin
takeaways.text: GAAP operating income was $575M — 41 cents of every revenue dollar — because revenue grew 70% while total operating expenses actually fell from a year ago.

takeaways.title: Record deal value closed
takeaways.text: Palantir closed $4.26B of total contract value in the quarter, up 138% YoY, including 180 deals of at least $1M.

oneTimers: Stock-based compensation of $196M sits inside cost of revenue and operating expenses; excluding it and related employer payroll taxes, adjusted operating income was $798M (a 57% margin) instead of $575M, and adjusted EPS was $0.25 vs $0.24 GAAP.
otherDetail: Interest income of $63M on Palantir's cash pile, less $17M of other expense — a net +$46M below operating profit (rounded from the release's thousands).
footerNote: Net income here is Palantir's total net income of $611M (reported as $611.6M before rounding); $609M of it is attributable to common stockholders (the rest belongs to noncontrolling interests). Segment figures are Palantir's FY2025 10-K segment revenue less the nine-month figures in its Q3 2025 10-Q, rounded to the nearest $M.
